newsitem.title: THAILAND: Export value of Jan-Nov Thai vehicles, parts up.
newsitem.headline: Export value of Jan-Nov Thai vehicles, parts up.

text.p: The value of Thai exports of assembled vehicles and parts rose 10.4 percent in the first 11 months of 1996 to 10.79 billion baht ($431.6 million) from 9.77 billion in the same year-ago period, an industry group said.

The export value of cars and car parts during January-November jumped 52.95 percent to 4.73 billion baht from 3.09 billion in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automobile Industry Association said in a statement on Thursday.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle parts in the period was down 9.24 percent to 6.06 billion baht from 6.68 billion over the similar year-ago period, it said.

The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand during January-November period was up 4.96 percent to 506,708 against 482,749 in the same period in the previous year, the association said.
